title: David Sills V 2019 Panini Absolute Rookie #197 Buffalo Bills WR
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2019 Panini Absolute sports trading card features David Sills V, a rookie player for the Buffalo Bills in the National Football League (NFL). The card number is 197 and it is a must-have for any football fan or sports trading card collector. The card showcases the player's name, team, and season, along with his unique features as a rookie.

The card is manufactured by Panini and is a part of the 2019 set. It is a great addition to any sports trading card collection, especially for fans of the Buffalo Bills and football in general. This card is not autographed and is categorized under Trading Card Singles and Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop. Get your hands on this amazing card today!
